reason: I run three AI agents every day and lose context every time I switch between them — that lost time costs me far more than $30 a month. One seat covers every agent I connect, so at my salary it's a no-brainer if it actually keeps sessions shared across Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex; the first five humans being free lets my team pilot it risk-free.
objection: We already pay for GitHub Copilot Enterprise — why add another tool, and if the local daemon (loomd) crashes it takes down shared context for all my agents at once.
would_change_my_mind: If loomd sent agent context off my machine or became a single point of failure that killed all my agents at once.
